user_reported_bug: The email still goes to junk mail. The attachments are not attached in the emails. See if you can wrap the email in "something" that ensures my pictures, embedded pictures, and attachments show up and display. I need professional emails to end up in inboxes.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend verification passed: legacy email image URLs preserve the required email/ prefix when rewritten, rewritten image URLs are publicly fetchable without cookies, already-public URLs are idempotent, email preview is wrapped in a full HTML5 document, Brevo attachment translation uses singular attachment, and a real test-only blast with an uploaded PDF attachment was accepted by Brevo (sent=1, failed=0). Inbox/junk placement cannot be guaranteed by code; remaining deliverability depends on DNS/domain authentication and reputation.
action_items: No code fix needed for the verified regression. For inbox placement, ensure the production sending domain is authenticated in Brevo with valid SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and return-path alignment; code cannot force mailbox providers to bypass junk filtering.
critical_code_review_comments: _normalize_email_images now rewrites /api/files/email/* to /api/email/image/email/* and only matches the legacy /api/files/email/ prefix, so already-public /api/email/image/email/* URLs are not double-rewritten.
The public /api/email/image/{storage_path:path} endpoint still rejects non-email storage paths and served the uploaded inline image anonymously with 200 image/png and matching bytes.
Admin.jsx still contains generic member-action text like 'Resend link' and 'Resend to all', but the Email Blast Admin/provider-facing section has no user-facing Resend provider brand string.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for requested code/text regression (no UI flow required)

seed_data_creation: Uploaded two small inline PNGs and one test PDF attachment via API; sent a test-only admin blast accepted by Brevo. The script deletes the uploaded attachment after send; uploaded image objects remain as harmless test artifacts in object storage/chat_files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run /app/test_reports/verify_email_bug_iteration105.py. It logs in as admin, uploads an inline image, verifies legacy preview rewrite to /api/email/image/email/{path}, anonymously fetches the rewritten image, checks idempotence for already-public URLs, verifies Brevo attachment translation, sends a test-only blast with a PDF attachment, checks wrapper helpers, confirms no Resend provider brand in the Email Blast Admin section, and reruns backend/tests/test_iteration146_wrapper_and_attachments.py.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous normalization rewrote /api/files/email/foo to /api/email/image/foo, dropping the email/ storage-path prefix required by the public image endpoint, so delivered-mail image proxy fetches 404ed. The fixed regex substitutes /api/files/email/ with /api/email/image/email/, preserving the scoped storage prefix. Attachment delivery had previously required translating Resend-style attachments to Brevo's singular attachment payload; this regression remains fixed.
